meta.name: cloudformation
meta.description: AWS CloudFormation infrastructure as code for stack management. Use when writing templates, deploying stacks, managing drift, troubleshooting deployments, or organizing infrastructure with nested stacks.

copy.tagline: 用代码管理 AWS 云资源与堆栈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用 CloudFormation 模板管理 AWS 基础设施
copy.tagline_en: Manage AWS cloud resources and stacks with code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage AWS infrastructure with CloudFormation templates

howto.what: Claude 能帮你编写 AWS CloudFormation 模板、部署和管理堆栈、检测配置漂移、排查部署问题，以及组织嵌套堆栈。
howto.when: 当你询问关于 AWS CloudFormation 模板编写、堆栈部署、漂移检测、部署故障排查或嵌套堆栈组织时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个创建 S3 存储桶的 CloudFormation 模板。
say.note: Claude 会生成 YAML 模板代码。

say.text: 如何检测我的 CloudFormation 堆栈是否有漂移？
say.note: Claude 会解释漂移检测命令。

say.text: 我的堆栈创建失败了，怎么排查原因？
say.note: Claude 会给出排查步骤和命令。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you write AWS CloudFormation templates, deploy and manage stacks, detect drift, troubleshoot deployments, and organize nested stacks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about CloudFormation template writing, stack deployment, drift detection, deployment troubleshooting, or nested stack organization.

say_en.text: Write a CloudFormation template to create an S3 bucket.
say_en.note: Claude will generate YAML template code.

say_en.text: How do I detect drift in my CloudFormation stack?
say_en.note: Claude will explain drift detection commands.

say_en.text: My stack creation failed, how to troubleshoot?
say_en.note: Claude will provide troubleshooting steps and commands.
